column1: ## S1 🔴 THE CLEANEST ROW IS CLEAR BECAUSE OF ONE DEFAULT, NOT ONE DECISION
# client/src/student/worker/detection.worker.ts, FaceLandmarker.createFromOptions:
#     baseOptions: { modelAssetPath: ".../face_landmarker.task", delegate: "GPU" },
#     runningMode: "VIDEO", numFaces: 1,
#     outputFacialTransformationMatrixes: true
# 🔴 `outputFaceBlendshapes` IS NOT SET. MediaPipe defaults it to false. Those blendshapes
# are the 52 expression coefficients (mouthSmile*, browDown*, …) — the nearest thing in the
# stack to affect, and the model asset already loaded computes from the same graph.
# 🔵 SO: one line, `outputFaceBlendshapes: true`, moves this repository from Annex III
# high-risk (duties 2027-12-02) into a LIVE Article 5 PROHIBITION at the Act's maximum
# penalty. That is the sentence to put in front of a client, and it is why "we checked, it
# does not infer emotion" is a statement about a configuration and not about a design.
# 🟢 What it DOES do that still needs a basis: face-api.js is loaded "for identity
# consistency check" — biometric IDENTIFICATION, GDPR Art. 9 special-category data, and
# Annex III point 3 "monitoring and detecting prohibited behaviour of students during tests".
# Clear of the prohibition is not clear of the duty.
## S2 🔴 A PUBLISHED ROW'S DESCRIPTION IS REFUTED BY ITS OWN SOURCE
# agents/top.md publishes:
#   "VIJAYAPANDIANT/online-examination-system | MIT | 11 | 2026-08-19 | Full exam platform
#    with AI proctoring; React/Vite + Spring Boot ... The most complete *platform* of the four."
# 🔴 There is no AI and no proctoring. No camera API is referenced anywhere outside
# node_modules; ExamJail.jsx enforces fullscreen, listens for visibilitychange and
# fullscreenchange, and blocks contextmenu. `com.exam.proctor` is a JAVA PACKAGE NAME.
# 🟢 The platform claim stands. The "AI proctoring" claim does not, and the row must say
# "browser-lock integrity events (fullscreen, tab-switch), no camera, no model".
# 🔵 Commercially this is the better row for an EU engagement, not the worse one: it
# delivers exam integrity signal with ZERO biometric processing, so it carries no Art. 9
# duty and no Annex III biometric exposure. The description was hiding its best property.
## S3 🔴 THE INSTRUMENT'S OWN DEFECT, recorded because it nearly produced a false accusation
# The first scan reported CLASS A hits on VIJAYAPANDIANT: emotion 3, emotionevent 5,
# emotioneventrotationrate 3, emotioneventacceleration 3, emotionelement 3, emotionml 2.
# 🔴 ALL SIXTEEN ARE FALSE POSITIVES, from TWO causes at once:
#   1. a case-insensitive SUBSTRING match for "emotion" fires inside "Devic eMotionEvent" —
#      "deviceMotionEventRotationRate" contains "emotioneventrotationrate".
#   2. every hit is in frontend/node_modules/ — mime-db/db.json carries the MIME type
#      application/emotionml+xml, and caniuse-lite/data/features/deviceorientation.js
#      carries the DOM event names.
# 🟢 FIXED by a leading word boundary (\bemotion) and excluding vendored trees. Re-run:
#      0 CLASS A hits in all three repositories.
# 🔵 THE CLASS GENERALISES, AND IT IS p189's LESSON ONE SEGMENT OVER: p189 found a
# SUBSTRING standing in for a PATH (LICENSE vs LICENSE.TXT). This is a SUBSTRING standing
# in for a TOKEN. 🔴 An unbounded token scan over a tree containing node_modules will
# accuse almost any JavaScript repository of inferring emotion.
## WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH
# 🔴 NOTHING WAS RUN. Three repositories were read as source at a pinned HEAD. A model
#   loaded at runtime from a CDN (both face models here are fetched from cdn.jsdelivr.net
#   and storage.googleapis.com at startup) can change without the repository changing.
# 🔴 THREE REPOSITORIES, and one of them is not a published row. ls1intum/Artemis is carried
#   from a previous pass's token census, not re-read this pass.
# 🔴 TOKENS, NOT BEHAVIOUR. A model that outputs an affect score under a neutral variable
#   name would pass this scan. The scan is a screen, not a clearance.
# 🔴 The Omnibus deferral does NOT apply to Art. 5 prohibitions; it moved Annex III duties
#   to 2027-12-02. Both facts are needed to read this table, and they point opposite ways.
